headline: AMD, Supermicro and Spectro Cloud Simplify Enterprise AI Coding with Turnkey, Local-First Infrastructure
summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., August 05, 2026--AMD, Spectro Cloud and Supermicro today announced AMD Instinct™ Coder, a co-designed turnkey, validated enterprise inference solution. The solution aims to help enterprises, cloud providers and sovereign AI operators run appropriate AI coding workloads, delivering the flexibility of running inference locally while preserving policy-based access to frontier models when their capabilities are required.

headline: AI and Chip Stocks Drop After Musk's Nvidia Bombshell
summary: Investors were once again trying to make sense of comments from Elon Musk on Wednesday, after the SpaceX CEO said his rocket and AI company would exclusively use Nvidia chips from now on.  AMD was the S&P 500's worst performer ahead of the opening bell, slumping 8.7% as Musk's announcement overshadowed a second-quarter earnings beat.  Nvidia's own shares climbed 2%.
